subject: environmental-science
title: Cycles & Systems: The Carbon Cycle
welcome_lead: Carbon moves between plants, animals, air and rocks — slowly or fast.
meta_desc: KS3 environmental science: carbon cycle, photosynthesis, respiration.
final_note: Cut the cycle and carbon piles up in the air — that's climate change.

concepts.def: Element found in all living things.
Plants making food from CO2 and sunlight.
Living things using food and releasing CO2.
Coal, oil or gas formed from dead plants.
Rotting which returns carbon to soil and air.

walkthroughs.body_html: Plants take in CO2 and water and use sunlight to make sugar — photosynthesis. They release oxygen back into the air.
Animals eat plants and breathe out CO2 — respiration. Decomposers break down dead matter, returning carbon to soil and air.
Burning fossil fuels releases carbon stored for millions of years. Extra CO2 traps heat and warms the planet.

numericals.q: How many main processes connect the carbon cycle in this lesson (photosynthesis, respiration, combustion)?
